instruction: Use ug-surveillance cameras to list all cameras with name, location and status. Read only. Do not return faces, plates or snapshots.

Use ug-document extract with schema auto and content-scope full on the file Invoices/Ana Ruiz - Nov 3.pdf. Return one row per billed visit with date, start time, end time, billed hours, hourly rate, line amount, worker name and number of workers, plus the exact text each value was read from.
